source: Butlin, Long, Elmoznino et al. 2023, arXiv:2308.08708 (indicator properties, sec. 2-3); updated in Butlin, Long, Bayne, Bengio, Birch, Chalmers et al., Trends Cogn Sci, doi:10.1016/j.tics.2025.10.011
disclaimer: Indicators are evidence-weighting heuristics under computational functionalism, not a test. Meeting or missing indicators does not show the model is or is not conscious. NEURALESE makes no consciousness, sentience or superintelligence claim.
model: TinyStories-8M (8 layers, d=256), feed-forward causal transformer run one token-pass at a time

indicators.why: Each forward pass is strictly feed-forward across 8 layers; the only recurrence is autoregressive re-reading of emitted tokens, which Butlin et al. discuss as not clearly satisfying RPT-1.
No perceptual modality; text-only tokens. Integration proxies are measured in P1 (PCI-style) but are not perceptual organisation.

indicators.text: Multiple specialised systems operating in parallel
indicators.why: Attention heads/MLP neurons are specialised (atlas P6 shows concentrated causal effects) but are not independent modules.

indicators.text: Limited-capacity workspace with bottleneck / selective attention
indicators.why: The residual stream is a shared broadcast channel of fixed width but has no competitive capacity bottleneck; attention is not a limited workspace in the GWT sense.
The residual stream is read by all later layers; this is architectural broadcast, not evidence of workspace dynamics.

indicators.text: State-dependent attention enabling sequential querying of modules
indicators.why: No control loop that queries modules in sequence within a pass.
Operationalised as Hill coefficient of the dose-response to concept injection (P2, H2a/H2b). See results.

indicators.text: Generative, top-down or noisy perception modules
Metacognitive monitoring distinguishing reliable representations from noise
indicators.why: Operationalised as (a) injected-concept detection probe P3a and (b) privileged self-prediction P3b. See results; neither alone establishes metacognition.

indicators.text: Agency guided by belief-formation and action selection with metacognitive updating
indicators.why: No agency; the model only predicts tokens.

indicators.text: Sparse and smooth coding generating a quality space
indicators.why: No sensory quality space to probe.

indicators.text: Predictive model representing and controlling attention
indicators.why: No component models its own attention.
Next-token prediction objective is not hierarchical predictive coding of inputs.

indicators.text: Agency: learning from feedback and selecting outputs to pursue goals
indicators.why: Frozen weights in the deployed model; the P4 loop is an external optimiser, not the model's own goals.
